# Every neo PR fails unit on the claim-responder sibling-repository case

## Context

`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs:1667` fails on `dev` at `2404340dfa`, so the `unit` check of every open `neomjs/neo` PR is red. Two of them: #21118, an outside contribution, and #21123. I reproduced it locally at `2404340dfa`: 1 failed, 37 passed.

```
Error: Incomplete state read for #1764: missing or malformed pagination metadata
```

The guard throwing it is `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml:126`.

Ownership: self-assigned. The curated contributor labels are left off because it blocks the required `unit` check of every PR.

Design authority: #21086. A linked-PR read without pagination metadata is incomplete and fails closed; it never reads as "no linked pull requests".

## The Problem

This is merge skew between two PRs that each passed CI on their own base:
- **#21092** (merged 2026-11-16 07:50Z, resolves #21084) added the sibling-repository case. Its `github.graphql` stub returns `{repository: {issue: {closedByPullRequestsReferences: {nodes: []}}}}`.
- **#21103** (merged 08:59Z, resolves #21086) made the claim-responder paginate linked PRs and fail closed when `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is not a boolean. It added `pageInfo: {hasNextPage: false}` to the three stubs on its base (spec lines 555, 721, 807), but #21092's case was not on that base.

## The Architectural Reality

- The fail-closed read is deliberate, so the stub is wrong, not the guard.
- `claimResponse.spec.mjs:1861` is the only `closedByPullRequestsReferences` stub without `pageInfo`.

## The Fix

Add `pageInfo: {hasNextPage: false}` to the stub at `claimResponse.spec.mjs:1861`, matching the other three.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.spec.mjs` passes 38/38.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml` is unchanged; its fail-closed pagination guard stays as it is.

## Out of Scope

- The claim-responder's pagination contract.
- Preventing this class of merge skew, e.g. by requiring up-to-date branches. That is a repository-policy question.

## Avoided Traps

- **Relaxing the guard so a missing `pageInfo` reads as one complete page.** That would reopen the gap #21086 closed: a truncated read would claim no linked PR exists.
